feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 September 2026 4:17pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 22 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is eroded from the northwest by a developing frontal wave.


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area, gradually veering north or northwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, decreasing 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches continuing to gradually clear. Rain then arriving from the northwest that will become heavy for a time before gradually clearing.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain or mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest, becoming variable overnight into Thursday, 2 to 4, settling southeast 4 or 5 during the morning, veering south 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
